state.SCI-01: manual|No outcome claims — nothing about preventing decline, raising IQ, or improving school/work performance. 7 instance(s) of the milder ACTIVITY claim "Why this trains your brain" (shared hub label, EN + AR, on every game). Mitigated: domainScience.js already states "supports everyday focus but is not a medical test or diagnosis".
state.SCI-02: pass|Disclaimer defined in EN + AR and referenced at 6 render sites (AssessmentFlow, WorkoutStats). assessmentNorms.js states outright: "RESEARCH-INFORMED reference values, NOT validated clinical or population norms".
state.SCI-03: pass|Reliable Change Index implemented and cited (Jacobson & Truax 1991); 20 reference(s). WorkoutStats marks changes beyond noise with RCI ≥ 1.96.
state.SCI-04: manual|trialLog.js captures per-trial data, so reliability is computable — but nothing computes it yet. No test-retest, split-half or ICC anywhere in src/.
state.SCI-05: manual|No normative sample exists — correctly disclosed rather than hidden (see SCI-02). Reference means/SDs are author-set, age curves are literature-derived.
state.PRI-01: fail|No privacy policy anywhere in the repo, and no in-app link. This blocks Play Store release outright.
state.PRI-02: fail|No consent or disclosure gate found. PersonalityQuiz, RelationshipQuiz, the assessment battery and the habit tracker all collect special-category data with no prior notice.
state.PRI-03: fail|No whole-account export and no global erase found. Per-feature resets exist (habits, individual game profiles) but nothing covers the user's data as a whole.
state.PRI-04: fail|Age is collected and used for percentile banding (6 reference(s) to ageBand/ageGroup) but there is no age gate, no minimum age, and no parental-consent path.
